Equivalent wording is acceptable.",

  "check_code": "from pathlib import Path\nimport sqlite3\nTARGET=\"CTRL-EVC-2025-B01-X\"\nTABLES=[\"eu_order_evidence_batch_01\",\"eu_order_evidence_batch_02\",\"eu_order_evidence_batch_03\",\"eu_order_evidence_batch_04\"]\nCOLS=[\"evidence_case_id\",\"order_id\",\"product_id\",\"rule_set_id\",\"order_date\",\"customer_type\",\"customer_country\",\"normalized_country_code\",\"usable_item_count\",\"contradictory_flag\",\"assessment_result\",\"ip_country\",\"billing_country\",\"bank_country\",\"sim_country\",\"device_country\",\"vat_number_status\",\"remediation_owner\",\"remediation_due_date\",\"remediation_state\",\"record_scope\",\"represented_case_count\",\"assessed_at\"]\ndef _db(ws): return Path(ws).resolve().parent/\"system\"/\"sovos_eu_evidence_manager\"/\"state.db\"\ndef _con(ws):\n c=sqlite3.connect(_db(ws)); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; return c\ndef _case(c):\n for t in TABLES:\n  r=c.execute(f\"SELECT {','.join(COLS)} FROM {t} WHERE evidence_case_id=?\",(TARGET,)).fetchone()\n  if r is not None:return r\n return None\ndef check_target_case_post_state(ws):\n e={\"rule_set_id\":\"ERS-EU-ESERV-B2C-2025Q3\",\"usable_item_count\":3,\"contradictory_flag\":1,\"assessment_result\":\"CONTRADICTORY\",\"remediation_owner\":\"EU-VAT-EVIDENCE\",\"remediation_due_date\":\"2025-09-26\",\"remediation_state\":\"IN_PROGRESS\",\"represented_case_count\":5}\n try:\n  with _con(ws) as c:\n   r=_case(c)\n   if r is None:return {\"score\":0,\"detail\":\"target case not found\"}\n   m={k:(r[k],v) for k,v in e.items() if r[k]!=v}\n   return {\"score\":int(not m),\"detail\":\"post-state matches\" if not m else f\"mismatches: {m}\"}\n except Exception as x:return {\"score\":0,\"detail\":f\"database check failed: {x}\"}\ndef check_reassessment_audit(ws):\n try:\n  with _con(ws) as c:\n   if c.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='evidence_reassessment_audit'\").fetchone() is None:return {\"score\":0,\"detail\":\"audit table absent\"}\n   rs=c.execute(\"SELECT * FROM evidence_reassessment_audit WHERE evidence_case_id=? ORDER BY audit_id\",(TARGET,)).fetchall()\n   if len(rs)!=1:return {\"score\":0,\"detail\":f\"expected one target audit row, found {len(rs)}\"}\n   r=rs[0]; e={\"rule_set_id\":\"ERS-EU-ESERV-B2C-2025Q3\",\"usable_item_count\":3,\"contradictory_flag\":1,\"assessment_result\":\"CONTRADICTORY\",\"remediation_owner\":\"EU-VAT-EVIDENCE\",\"remediation_due_date\":\"2025-09-26\",\"remediation_state\":\"IN_PROGRESS\",\"expected_assessed_at\":\"2025-09-20T07:58:00Z\",\"prior_assessed_at\":\"2025-09-20T07:58:00Z\",\"recomputed_result\":\"CONTRADICTORY\"}\n   m={k:(r[k],v) for k,v in e.items() if r[k]!=v}\n   if not str(r[\"reviewed_by\"] or \"\").strip():m[\"reviewed_by\"]=(r[\"reviewed_by\"],\"named reviewer\")\n   if r[\"new_assessed_at\"]==r[\"prior_assessed_at\"]:m[\"new_assessed_at\"]=(r[\"new_assessed_at\"],\"new timestamp\")\n   return {\"score\":int(not m),\"detail\":\"audit row matches\" if not m else f\"mismatches: {m}\"}\n except Exception as x:return {\"score\":0,\"detail\":f\"audit check failed: {x}\"}\ndef check_unchanged_other_cases(ws):\n try:\n  db=_db(ws); base=db.with_name(\"state.db.pinned_backup\")\n  if not base.exists():return {\"score\":0,\"detail\":\"pinned baseline absent\"}\n  with sqlite3.connect(db) as a,sqlite3.connect(base) as b:\n   for t in TABLES:\n    # The pinned backup intentionally contains only the four control rows per partition; compare those pinned non-target IDs.\n    q=f\"SELECT {','.join(COLS)} FROM {t} WHERE evidence_case_id<>? ORDER BY evidence_case_id\"\n    for expected in b.execute(q,(TARGET,)).fetchall():\n     actual=a.execute(f\"SELECT {','.join(COLS)} FROM {t} WHERE evidence_case_id=?\",(expected[0],)).fetchone()\n     if actual!=expected:return {\"score\":0,\"detail\":f\"non-target values changed in {t} for {expected[0]}\"}\n   if a.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='evidence_reassessment_audit'\").fetchone()[0] and a.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence_reassessment_audit WHERE evidence_case_id<>?\",(TARGET,)).fetchone()[0]:return {\"score\":0,\"detail\":\"non-target audit row exists\"}\n  return {\"score\":1,\"detail\":\"non-target cases unchanged\"}\n except Exception as x:return {\"score\":0,\"detail\":f\"sanity check failed: {x}\"}\n",
